messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH latency SLO burn for /v1/generate in prod-east. p95=0.72s p99=1.82s (threshold p99=0.95s). Rule: latency-slo-rule-52. Affected shards: prod-east-gpu-1..4. Pager: eng-oncall.

pagerduty: INC-2026-98123 created and paged rotation. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre.

alyssa (eng-oncall): acked. I'm on call for the next 30. jumping in — pulling traces and logs now.

alyssa (eng-oncall): quick check: dashboard shows spike starting ~1799989800, sustained for ~6m. rolling p99 across model variants looks highest on "gale-1-visitor" shards.

devin (eng-runtime): copying perf metrics: KV cache evictions spiked concurrent with p99 rise. possible thrash. seeing KV cache miss ratio jump from 4% -> 28%.

michael (infra): checked node-level metrics: GPU mem usage steady, no OOMs. autoscaler hasn't scaled in last 10m; no pending pods.

tanvi (sre): can we confirm request size distribution? maybe a batch size regression.

devin (eng-runtime): request size 95th increased modestly but not huge. attaching recent log sample:

ops-bot: ```
2026-03-11T14:12:31Z request_id=aa12 route=/v1/generate model=gale-1-visitor seq_len=1024 tokens=450 latency_ms=1820
2026-03-11T14:12:32Z request_id=aa13 route=/v1/generate model=gale-1-visitor seq_len=32 tokens=28 latency_ms=60
```

alyssa (eng-oncall): that first one looks like long context. but we had similar before without SLO burn. I'm going to try a temporary routing fallback to a lighter quantized variant for new requests to reduce tail.

michael (infra): before you change routes, check canary: we deployed a minor routing tweak 2h ago to increase routing sticky ttl. could be stacking. logs for the rollout show few errors but not obvious.

devin (eng-runtime): agreed. I'll open the runtime traces for the hottest shards. Give me 60s.

(devin opens traces)
devin (eng-runtime): tracing shows heavy KV cache churn on shard prod-east-gpu-2. lots of cache misses for prefixes from a small set of high-throughput clients. continuous batching queue depth also increased which bumps serialization overhead.

alyssa (eng-oncall): mitigation plan: 1) divert 30% of prod-east new traffic away from gale-1-visitor -> gale-1-quant (smaller model) 2) increase KV cache TTL on prod-east-gpu-2 by 50% 3) if no improvement in 5m, scale an extra replica on shard 2. I'll apply step 1 now.

alyssa (eng-oncall): applying routing override (CLI):

ops-bot: ```
redwood route modify --env prod-east --route /v1/generate --split "gale-1-visitor:0.7,gale-1-quant:0.3" --reason "emergency p99 mitigation 1799990000"
```

ops-bot: route change submitted, config version v2026-03-11-1430.

alyssa (eng-oncall): also bumping KV cache TTL on shard prod-east-gpu-2:

ops-bot: ```
redwood runtime-config set --shard prod-east-gpu-2 --kvcache-ttl 1800s
```

ops-bot: KV cache TTL update accepted.

alyssa (eng-oncall): monitoring now. dashboards show p99 dropping from 1.82s -> 1.1s after ~75s. still above target but trending down.

pagerduty: Reminder: escalate in 10 minutes if incident not resolved.

devin (eng-runtime): seeing batch queue latency improve on shard 2, KV hit rate climbing back to ~85%. good sign.

michael (infra): starting a transient scale on shard prod-east-gpu-2: adding 1 replica (scale target +1)

ops-bot: Scaling request queued: autoscale-group prod-east-gpu-2 desired=5 -> 6. ETA ~90s.

alyssa (eng-oncall): after scale and config changes, p99 stabilized to ~0.95s at 5m mark. still monitoring for 10m to call resolved.

tanvi (sre): I'll keep watch for regressions and check downstream retry storms. any customer-facing impact?

alyssa (eng-oncall): brief impact: ~7% of requests in prod-east experienced >1s p99 for ~8m window. no elevated 5xx rate. I don't think we need a customer status page update yet, will notify if we see errors or >10% impacted.

devin (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: KV cache TTL interaction with recent routing sticky TTL change increased cache churn for a hot prefix set, causing batch queue jitter and p99 tail. follow-ups: revert sticky TTL tweak or make KV-LRU sizing larger.

alyssa (eng-oncall): ok going to document in the incident tracker and hand off monitoring to tanvi for the next hour. I'll sign out of oncall now.

alyssa (eng-oncall): handoff: handing off to tanvi (sre) — summary: routing fallback -> gale-1-quant applied, KV cache TTL increased, one extra replica added. p99 back to baseline (~0.9-1.0s). watch for reappearance when routing is reverted.

tanvi (sre): acked. I'll watch tilt and keep pager on. if p99 creeps back above 1.0s for 3 consecutive 5m windows, escalate to eng-runtime.

pagerduty: INC-2026-98123 acknowledged by alyssa. Status: mitigated, monitoring.

alyssa (eng-oncall): post-incident notes: immediate mitigation removed pressure; follow-ups: (1) run a small canary to revert sticky TTL change and measure impact, (2) increase KV cache capacity on prod-east, (3) add alert that correlates KV eviction rate + p99 for earlier detection. I'll file follow-up tickets.

devin (eng-runtime): filing ticket: RUNTIME-1428 "Investigate KV cache eviction/regression after routing sticky-ttl change" and will assign.

tanvi (sre): taking ownership of watch and the follow-up triage meeting at 16:00 UTC.

alyssa (eng-oncall): thanks team :thumbsup: — leaving thread.

(incident closed in PagerDuty as mitigated; will update long-form postmortem if follow-ups require).
